findings.title: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: Package states < 10 g/L; spec requires at most 250 g/L.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: astm g21 rating
findings.detail: Firestopping materials shall have mold and mildew resistance rating of zero(0) in accordance with ASTM G21.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed mold resistance, the material could degrade in damp areas and fail when needed most.

findings.title: Pending assembly proof
findings.detail: Product data does not establish a specific assembly's F/T ratings. Confirm the listed assembly separately.
findings.why_it_matters: We must verify the actual wall/floor assembly rating to ensure the firestop will perform correctly in your specific condition.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Test standards
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: Proof of proper fire testing ensures the product will actually stop flames and smoke spread during a fire.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed L70 life, we cannot ensure the lights will maintain adequate brightness over time.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Warranty
findings.detail: Warranty Period for LED Luminaires, including LED modules, LED boards, chips, and drivers: Five (5) years from date of Preliminary Acceptance.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing warranty info leaves us unprotected if fixtures fail early.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: No DLC proof means we may miss energy rebates or fail to meet efficiency goals.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: macadam steps
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: Unverified binning risks visible color differences between fixtures.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Dims down to
findings.detail: Continuous dimming from 100 to 5 percent without flicker.
findings.why_it_matters: If dimming isn’t smooth and flicker-free, it could cause discomfort or issues with controls.
